test_title: PYST 59: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 14th November 2021 Shift 1)

question:
Select the box(es) that can be formed by folding the given sheet along the lines.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6606df785b7415470a9455e5bcf0a986fb5e43c7d8ca75f205e12e046a5440af.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f897b5e165ae4d53ebf6035d98feb26f4a7bcc15f4dc546ac8d23e234ccfc97.png]
solution:
Faces opposite to each other is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3cf686eb43c0122bf5402132b568e303b5ca72d6095d3a59825629b1866df7e8.png] 

__
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81ea6acc3ee8194340a56e21355cdd1eb525517c2a11e2bac1238078f0d2c871.png] → It can be formed.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/133714cf84f1c81884fa8c13b2119637cee5122f2e7a7dc2b7a6db1d4d79eba0.png] → It cannot be formed as 2 is to the right side of 5, so it cannot be at the top of 5.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/60fc6125ec0c1817260b0cc7d306f298fbbb48df148b415a3db8992b80203cee.png] → It cannot be formed as 4 and 2 are faces opposite to each other.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e83483af87faa8e75ec37da0965e54f62d65c752710c5dc0f2bd958cefe7ef6.png] → It cannot be formed as 5 and 3 are faces opposite to each other.

Hence, '**Only A**' is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **Mistake Points__**
